Use the Incompetech format: "Procession of the King" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0, with a link to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Put it on a Credits screen that is easy to find and not hidden. If the file is changed (for example re-encoded with edited loop points or fades), the credit must say it was modified. Hosting the file in a public R2 bucket counts as "Share" under CC BY 4.0, so the attribution should also travel with the catalog entry (in its metadata or license field). There is no region or Premium restriction.
